subject.title: fix(github-copilot): reject unvalidated OAuth enterprise domain on refresh

question: Should OpenClaw accept this fail-closed policy for legacy GitHub Copilot OAuth profiles, requiring reauthentication whenever their persisted enterprise origin is outside the supported allowlist?
rationale: The patch is technically correct and prevents credential egress, but it intentionally changes upgrade behavior for existing stored profiles at an authentication and credential-origin security boundary.

options.title: Accept rejection and reauthentication
options.body: Land the patch so unsupported persisted origins never receive credentials and affected users must reauthenticate through the documented onboarding path.

options.title: Require a different recovery policy
options.body: Pause the PR and specify another secure recovery flow that neither transmits nor silently repoints the existing credential.

recommendation.title: Accept rejection and reauthentication
recommendation.body: Land the patch so unsupported persisted origins never receive credentials and affected users must reauthenticate through the documented onboarding path.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current auth-diagnostics seam and is the strongest history-backed owner for accepting the recovery behavior.
